Amenities include a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, and coffee shop, and we're just steps from Metro North. With Hudson Park North, Hudson Park South, and River Club all included in our community, we offer multiple floorplan options at various price points. River Club is our most luxurious offering with exclusive amenities. With studio, 1- and 2-bedroom unit options, schedule your tour today so we can help you find your perfect home!

Discover the space, comfort, and connection that make Crestwood Lake feel like home.

desc:
Introducing Miroza Tower III at 601 Ridge Hill Boulevard. Perched atop one of Yonker's seven hills, Miroza at Ridge Hill is ideally located 30 minutes from midtown Manhattan and offers a 24-hour concierge as well as a convenient shuttle to Metro North. Miroza is next door to the acclaimed Ridge Hill shopping center, a veritable shopping mecca with stores like Whole Foods, The Apple Store, H&M, and the Legoland Discovery Center (to name just a few). You're just a quick ride to downtown Yonkers, with its many boutiques, galleries, restaurants, and scenic waterfront. Discover cultural gems like the stunning Untermyer Gardens Conservatory, the Hudson River Museum and Planetarium, and the Science Barge.

Each home is brand new, with top-of-line finishes and stylish details including:

- Bright and airy open concept chef's kitchens with breakfast bar
- Stainless steel appliance package that includes dishwashers and microwaves
- Washer/dryers standard in each unit
- Sleek designer bathrooms with deep soaking tubs
- Double paned, extra large windows (some floor to ceiling) that reveal blue sky and bring in extra sunshine
- Stunning hardwood floors throughout
- Split systems for heating and cooling that you control
- Select units feature terraces and stunning western views - ideal perches for relaxing, entertaining, and convening with the natural landscape.

Our one-of-a-kind amenities center is a stand-alone complex that houses a variety of recreational activities:
- All-season indoor pool, sauna, and hot tub
- Indoor basketball court, fully-equipped gym and running track
- Resident lounge with bar and kitchen
- Children's playroom and screening room
- Outdoor patio / lounge with scenic overlook

Come see why Yonker's is NYC's 6th borough!

Pricing may reflect a net price with concessions.

Amenities include a roof deck overlooking the Long Island Sound and southern views of NYC skyline, fully equipped fitness center with separate fitness studio, elegant resident lounge and a hotel-like lobby complete with coffee bar. There is onsite parking, bike storage and a professional onsite management team. 

Outside, everything is at your doorstep - The Capital Theatre is across the street, The Metro North is a 1 minute walk, 50 minutes to Grand Central. Convenient shopping at the Waterfront at Port Chester (Costco, Stop & Shop, AMC Port Chester 14), fantastic dining around the corner: bartaco, Talia, Felice, Colony Grill, Five Iron Golf, and The Kneaded Bread are all within the village core, and Rye Town Park and Oakland Beach are a short drive away.

The Magnolia is a one of a kind experience delivering the very best of Port Chester.

desc: No Broker Fee. Wake up on the water at The Mariner and live the life you've always dreamed of. No one has the apartment space, location or Concierge level services that we offer in Porchester. Gas stoves in every apt of course! Experience waterfront luxury in the heart of it all with just a five minute walk to the Metro North train. No broker or mounting costs such as amenities fees or sewer, water, trash fees. Just parking and pets are extra. Get your morning exercise in our free stylish fitness center or take it outside for a jog with your dog on the nearby River Trail. In the afternoon take your boat out from one of our many boat slips or rent one from just across the way. Join the daily fishing Charter that leaves from our dock. At night visit one of Port Chester's upscale outdoor riverside restaurants such as Colony Grill or the legendary Bar Taco right at our door step. When you want to get out and explore, the beaches of Rye and Greenwich are just next door. During fall/winter they even let your dog run off leash. The Mariner is a full service, luxury rental building. In addition to free on-site fitness, residents also enjoy concierge, covered parking, penthouse level club lounge, on-site storage, dry cleaning services and we are pet friendly. All residences are spacious with high end finishes, appliances and details. Each has an in unit washer/dryer and is cable ready for both Optimum and Fios. Many have large walk in closets. Residents can relax at the end of a long day on our landscaped roof deck complete with bbq area and spectacular harbor views and Friday night fireworks. Come live life to the fullest at The Mariner your waterfront escape.

desc: Welcome to 30 Broad a brand-new collection of studios and one-bedrooms rising at 30 Broad Street, in the middle of everything downtown Port Chester has become. It's a piece of the block: a modern building with a vintage soul, set on a heritage brick base and anchored by Run & Hide Brewing Co. Windows frame the town skyline. Everything is solid, quiet, and yours.

desc: Welcome to The Altos (formerly known as Avalon White Plains), where elevated living meets unmatched convenience in Downtown White Plains. Our luxury apartment community offers studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes with gourmet kitchens, private terraces, in-unit washers/dryers, and modern finishes. Located just blocks from White Plains Metro-North station, enjoy seamless access to NYC while surrounded by vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment. World-class amenities include a resort-style pool, 24-hour fitness center, resident lounge, concierge service, garage parking, and Amazon HUB package lockers. Our pet-friendly community features sustainable design with ENERGY STAR appliances. From our passionate team dedicated to exceptional service to our prime Westchester location, The Altos puts everything within reach. This is apartment living reimagined, where home rises to the lifestyle you've earned. Experience modern comfort in a community designed for how you live today.

desc:
Hamilton Crossing offers the perfect mix of sophisticated urban luxe and exceptional suburban living. Welcome to life without compromise. A coveted downtown location just moments away from bustling Mamaroneck avenue and a private residential community packed with amenities. It's all here at Hamilton Crossing - from a sundrenched outdoor pool to our rooftop co-working lounge with sun deck and state-of-the art fitness center. This is your chance to live at the crossing of life and style, work and fun, convenience and serenity. Welcome home!

Some photos may have been virtually staged to show furnishing potential.

Approval Standards: Where applicable, approvals are based on the gross rent, not the net effective rent.

Upfront fees to be paid, not included in the monthly rent, are:

Holding Fee: $500 (Applied to first month's rent. Refund in full if application is denied or cancelled within 72 hours.)
1st Month's Rent: One Month's Rent (minus the holding fee if paid, due within 48 hours from application approval)
Security Deposit: One Month's Rent (Due within 48 hours of application approval)
Monthly Pet Fee: $50 (Per Pet, Per Month, Max 2 Pets).
Pet Fee: $500 (One Time, at Move-In, Non-refundable)
Single Application Fee: $20 (Per Applicant, Non-refundable)
Bike Storage: $25 (Per Bike, Per Month)
Amenities Fee: $80 (Per Unit, Per Month, Mandatory)
Extra Storage: $75-$175 (Per Month, Based on Storage Size)
Transfer/Roommate Change/Lease Admin Fee: $1000 (at Time of Lease Change) 
Lockout Fee: $50 (Per Lockout)
NSF Fee: $75
Late Fee: $50
Key Replacement: $50 per fob key (mailbox key is $25 and parking tag is $50)
Social Lounge Reservation: $75-$125 (Per Hour, Rules and Restrictions Apply)
Parking: 1st vehicle ($170+tax) 2nd vehicle ($250+tax) (First-come, first-served, EV charging stations are pay-per-use)
